title_zh: 约好按收集点要求处理剩余涂料

scenario.label_zh: 询问剩余涂料的分类与收集
scenario.goal_zh: 询问剩余涂料与空罐的处理方式，并约定先保留原罐查清接收要求

context_zh: 居民向社区废物收集点询问一次家庭刷漆后的剩余材料。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I have some excess paint left after decorating. How should I dispose of it?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Our paint disposal point accepts some products, but I need the label details before I can tell you whether yours is included.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: Can I discard the cans once I have poured the paint into a smaller container?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Please keep it in the original cans for now. We need those labels to check the collection rules.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: One can is empty and two still contain paint. Should I send details of all three?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Yes. Send the product names and tell us which can is empty; I will check the requirements for each.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I will do that and wait for your reply before moving or throwing anything away.
